title: Alien autopsy photos in S4 briefing

tellings.quote: I guess if you want to call it a gray something small. It had a T cut in the chest and there was one single organ removed from the chest.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at a secret site called S4 in the Nevada desert around 1988 and 1989, says the briefing papers he read there included autopsy photos of a small gray being. He tells it as something he saw himself: the body had a T-shaped cut in the chest, and one single organ had been taken out. If true, it would mean the government had a body that was not human and had studied it.
